children.text: Write a PNG of every design
Saved beside each design, so pull requests show image diffs.
Hints for the agents that build a design. The canvas draws Ultrapaint’s own components either way.
The app designs are built in, with its package.json. None is needed to design.
Folders whose components agents may use.
Detect moves from a row to the page header (‘Detect again’): it fills the whole page, so it sits over it.
Components: one field per folder with a remove ×, and Add a folder, not a textarea of lines.
Labels shortened: Path → Folder, Designs directory → Designs.
The Configuration file row goes: each project page names its file beside its title. Rename and Save to file… become a notice at the page’s top when they apply.
